title: Determination of new objective parameters for the diagnosis of insomnia
summary: The aim of the study is to identify changes in the electroencephalogram (EEG) during sleep allowing objective detection and assessment of the severity degree of insomnia. For this purpose sleep parameters are recorded at home in the course of 3 consecutive nights using the “HST REM+” sensor. Results will be compared afterwards with self-assessment using questionnaires.

interventions.name: Study participants receive a home sleep measurement for 3 consecutive nights

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- patients with suspicion of primary insomnia
or
- healthy people without sleep disorders based anamnesis
Exclusion criteria:
- patients with suspected or known existing other sleep disorders (e. g. OSA, PLM)
- patients with pimary insomnia receiving drug therapy
- participation in clinical pharmacological trials 4 weeks before the start of the study
- known or acute psychiatric / neurological illnesses or mental disorders occurring during the study that impair compliance
- significant cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, or malignant diseases that require medical treatment
- drug use, alcohol abuse
